features.name: unique-menu-icons
features.notes: gen1+gen2 source; ships Gen 2 party/menu icons

icon_color_mode.label: ICON COLORS
icon_color_mode.help: ORIGINAL uses the game palette, GBC RED is the Gen 2 red duotone, UNIQUE COLORS gives every Pokémon its own colours.

features.name: touch-tools
features.notes: gen1+gen2 source; native touch speed and voxel-view buttons

enabled.label: RUN
enabled.help: Run on the overworld instead of walking.

mode.label: RUN MODE
mode.help: Hold B, or toggle it on and off.

features.name: quality-of-life
features.notes: gen1+gen2 source; on Gen 2 only DEVICE CLOCK applies

access.label: OPEN BOXES FROM
access.help: Start menu, the Pokémon Center PC, or both.

heal.label: HEAL IN BOX
heal.help: A Pokémon taken out of a box is healed.

touch.label: TOUCH CONTROLS
touch.help: Drag and tap the box with the touchscreen.

anim.label: BOX ANIMATIONS
anim.help: Animate the Pokémon in the grid: all, one at a time, or off.

animate.label: ANIMATED WALLPAPER
animate.help: The wallpaper drifts instead of sitting still.

slots.label: SLOT SHADING
slots.help: How opaque each slot is over the wallpaper.

bands.label: HEADER BAND
bands.help: Opacity of the box title and footer bands.

placeCry.label: CRY WHEN PLACED
placeCry.help: Play the cry when a Pokémon is put down.

owSprites.label: OVERWORLD SPRITES
owSprites.help: Use overworld sprites in the box; needs the Wilds of Kanto mod.

peek.label: PEEK NEXT BOX
peek.help: Show the neighbouring boxes at the screen edge.

fullscreen.label: FULL SCREEN
fullscreen.help: Use the whole screen for the box.

wrap.label: CURSOR WRAP
wrap.help: Moving past an edge wraps to the opposite side.

trade_level.label: TRADE EVO LEVEL
trade_level.help: Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler and Haunter evolve at this level.

item_level.label: ITEM EVO LEVEL
item_level.help: Level needed to evolve holding King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale or Up-Grade.

patches.find: local function active(game)return game and game.mods and game.mods.exports.MOVESET_PLUS_GEN2~=nil end
patches.replace: local function active(game)return game and game.mods and game.mods.exports.{product}~=nil end

features.name: move-relearn
features.notes: gen1+gen2+gen3 source; loads after Moveset Plus, which owns the same screens
